content_payload.front_text: CV = long vowel   CVC = short vowel

slides.teacher_cue: New decoding strategy — the open/closed syllable rule. A closed syllable ends in a consonant: the vowel is short (cab·in, rab·bit, pup·pet). An open syllable ends in a vowel: the vowel is long (ba·by, he·ro, mu·sic). This rule explains why baby has a long /eɪ/ in ba- and cabin has a short /æ/ in cab-. When you see an unknown multi-syllable word, find the syllable boundaries first — then apply the rule.
slides.expected_response: Students apply the open/closed syllable rule to decode unfamiliar multi-syllable words.
slides.correction_move: Model: cover the second syllable of baby — ba — it ends in a vowel = open = long /eɪ/. Cover the second syllable of cabin — cab — it ends in b = closed = short /æ/. Students sort word cards.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students applying short vowel in open syllables. Redirect: if the syllable ends in a vowel, that vowel says its name.

slides.teacher_cue: Say baby. ba is open — vowel at end — long /eɪ/. by is open — y=/iː/. Reveal and blend by syllable.
slides.expected_response: Students say baby orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model baby orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /eɪ/ in the open first syllable.

slides.teacher_cue: Say cabin — a small house. cab is closed — ends in b — short /æ/. in is closed. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say cabin orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model cabin orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for short /æ/ in the closed first syllable — contrast with baby.

slides.teacher_cue: Say robot. ro is open — long /oʊ/. bot is closed — short /ɒ/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say robot orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model robot orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /oʊ/ in open ro.

slides.teacher_cue: Say music. mu is open — long /juː/. sic is closed — short /ɪ/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say music orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model music orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /juː/ in open mu and soft c = /z/ in sic.

slides.teacher_cue: Say basic — fundamental. ba open — long /eɪ/. sic closed — short /ɪ/. Reveal and blend.

slides.teacher_cue: Say unit — a single thing. u is open — long /juː/. nit is closed — short /ɪ/. Reveal and blend.

slides.correction_move: Model unit orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for open single-vowel syllable u = /juː/.
